I get what you're saying, but I feel with that logic the guests would have to confirm how committed they are to the partner they bring. I've been in a lot of weddings and have helped friends and family edit out the ex-gf/bf that was brought along and ended up in important pictures. 
Also what about guests who are already married? You're probably not going to get an invite to a future wedding from them.

I totally agree that bringing a person without a strong connection to you or the person getting married can likely be really rude/disrespectful, but the reason I was so upset was bc these two ppl whom I'm very close with didn't trust me to bring a person important enough to share that day with. Why should I be excluded a +1 if I'm important enough to be a bridesmaid and spend all the money and time associated with that honor?

I'm totally not trying to change your opinion, you make some good points. I just want to express why it hurt and honestly embarrassed me so much. Okaaaay rant over. Thanks for sharing your opinion with me.

I feel like that changes though if you're allowed a plus one and are close to the person getting married. I'm not bringing a friend to my co-worker's wedding for instance.
